notes.title: Blind_ Update
notes.content:
Based on feedback, received there have been a few changes made to the game.

-Shifting will no longer clear your memory, making it less disorienting (This effects levels 45-55)
-Changed Final level 1 to better reflect the concept behind it

-Fixed audio issues
-edited a few sprites for enhanced visibility
